SELECT rc.case_id AS caseId, rc.report_type AS reportType, rc.target_id AS targetId, rc.reported_member_id AS reportedMemberId, reported_member.nickname AS reportedMemberNickname,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member_report count_report WHERE count_report.case_id = rc.case_id ) AS reporterCount,
rc.status AS status, rc.process_reason AS processReason, rc.created_at AS createdAt, rc.processed_at AS processedAt, rc.restricted_until AS restrictedUntil
FROM report_case rc
JOIN members reported_member ON reported_member.member_id = rc.reported_member_id
ORDER BY rc.created_at DESC, rc.case_id DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
